motion_base.note: Diane NOT speaking - lips closed and still for the whole clip. Generated with the locked CONFIG 1 prompt and negative prompt, byte-exact from docs/VIDEO_1_GENERATION_CONFIGS.md. Native 1920x1080. 1 of 4 draws passed QA; the other three failed on camera drift (0.24/0.60/0.63 vs gate 0.1) or a moving mouth.

driving_base.method: base2's 241 frames reordered into a continuous walk. Every output frame is a bit-exact copy; only the ORDER changes. ffmpeg only, $0.00.
driving_base.join_size: 0.738 vs base2's own max consecutive-frame step of 0.657
guarantees: no cut outside the 103 declared joins
no blink ever played in reverse
direction changes ~1.4 s apart - drifts rather than nods

lipsync.loop_mode_note: Never triggers: each driving window exceeds its audio.

split.method: Re-encoded at the cut; a stream copy snaps to the nearest keyframe and would desync the remuxed audio. Frame count rounded UP so video always covers the audio.
split.measured: frames and video_dur_s are ffprobe measurements of the delivered v4 asset on 2026-08-21, not values carried over from an earlier revision. video_start_s is the batch offset snapped DOWN to the 25 fps frame grid; align_err_ms is that snap (video_start_s - batch_start_s), always <= 0, so the cut never starts late.

audio.note: LatentSync's returned audio (aac 16 kHz) is DISCARDED; the locked 24 kHz -24.5 LUFS master is remuxed with -c:a copy.

delivery.native: NO upscaling anywhere - base2 is native 1920x1080

measured.mouth_cheek_reference: approved demo 0.85, prior v2 0.84 - lower is softer, which is the correct direction; the rejected demo-driven set inverted to 1.10 and read as pasted on
measured.head_rms_note: Below the prior v2 (2.08) and well below the approved demo (6.16). KNOWN LIMITATION: base2 was generated from the locked prompt, which asks her to hold still. Fixing this needs a new base generated with a movement-positive prompt (lips still closed), ~$0.50 per draw plus a segment regeneration.

revision.reason: v3 drove LatentSync from the approved demo's own footage, in which Diane is already speaking. Repainting a mouth over a moving mouth inverted the mouth/face sharpness to 1.10 and left her jaw following the demo's words - rejected on review. v4 drives from a purpose-made clip in which her lips are closed, which restores a clean mouth and returns delivery to native 1920x1080.
